parsed.rationale: Both `MockHLSAVPlayer.play` and `MockPlayer.play` live under test-support paths (`Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/` and `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/`) within the `Playback` package. A `play()` method with an empty signature is the minimal stub any mock of a player protocol must provide; its structural identity is an artefact of both types conforming to the same player interface rather than a sign of extractable shared logic. The context flags report `is_mock: false`, but the file names (`MockHLSAVPlayer.swift`, `MockPlayer.swift`) and directory paths (`Mocks/`) make the mock nature unambiguous. Consolidating these two stubs into a shared default implementation would couple two otherwise independent mock types and offer no meaningful reduction in code.
